resharper_csharp_use_indent_from_previous_element #

Other indents — Use previous element's indent on partial format. Inert for a whole-file format, which is the only thing the oracle profile does; it governs a partial reformat. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified unreachable. Flat at both values on three fixtures. It governs what a partial reformat takes its indent from, and the oracle profile only ever reformats whole files, so no oracle fixture can reach it.
